explanation: This fires only at the GO step in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93 onward): it reads about 8-10 when the previous trial was rewarded and the agent picks a2, which is often a switch to a2 after a run of a1 choices. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, 0 before about trial 93, 0 whenever the previous trial was unrewarded, and usually 0 for a1 choices, which only rarely reach about 8, for example right after a rewarded rare transition.
